headline.purpose: Page titles: Discover and product name.

card-title.purpose: Product names in cards and combobox rows.

body-sm.purpose: Review notes, meta, rating counts, buttons, tabs.

motion.name: state-transition

selection.purpose: Text selection tint; the one ambient jade use.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action: sign in, log a tasting, submit a rating.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font-lato), Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:none; border-radius:8px; background:var(--primary, #171717); color:var(--primary-foreground, #f9f9f9); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:all .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity:.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #a1a1a1) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action, e.g. Load more reviews.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { font-family: var(--font-lato), Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid var(--border, #d4d4d4); border-radius:8px; background:var(--background, #f9f9f9); color:var(--foreground, #101010); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05); cursor:pointer; transition:all .15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:var(--accent, #f5f5f5); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #a1a1a1) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field and combobox search input.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Search by name or brand" />
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: var(--font-lato), Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; height:36px; width:100%; max-width:320px; padding:4px 12px; border:1px solid var(--input, #e5e5e5); border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:var(--foreground, #101010); font-size:14px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05); transition:border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--muted-foreground, #737373); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--ring, #a1a1a1); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #a1a1a1) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Category Badge
components.description: Pill marking a product's category in its data colour.
components.css: .ds-badge { font-family: var(--font-lato), Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:9999px; font-size:12px; line-height:16px; font-weight:600; } .ds-badge-matcha { background:var(--matcha, #5c7a4f); color:var(--matcha-foreground, #fff); } .ds-badge-hojicha { background:var(--hojicha, #8f6224); color:var(--hojicha-foreground, #fff); }

components.name: Category Tabs
components.description: Segmented All / Matcha / Hojicha filter; active tab fills with its category colour.
components.html: AllMatchaHojicha
components.css: .ds-tabs { font-family: var(--font-lato), Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display:inline-flex; gap:4px; padding:4px; border:1px solid var(--border, #d4d4d4); border-radius:10px; } .ds-tab { padding:6px 12px; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; color:var(--muted-foreground, #737373); text-decoration:none; transition:color .15s, background .15s; } .ds-tab:hover { color:var(--foreground, #101010); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring, #a1a1a1); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-tab-matcha[aria-current] { background:var(--matcha, #5c7a4f); color:var(--matcha-foreground, #fff); }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Whole-card link with 4px category spine, badge, meta and star rating.
components.css: .ds-card { font-family: var(--font-lato), Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display:block; max-width:340px; padding:16px; border:1px solid var(--border, #d4d4d4); border-left:4px solid var(--hojicha, #8f6224); border-radius:10px; background:var(--card, #f9f9f9); color:var(--foreground, #101010); text-decoration:none; box-shadow:0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / .1); transition:box-shadow .15s; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow:0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / .1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / .1); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--background, #f9f9f9), 0 0 0 4px var(--ring, #a1a1a1); } .ds-card-head { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; gap:8px; } .ds-card-title { margin:0; font-size:16px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.25; } .ds-muted { margin:0; color:var(--muted-foreground, #737373); font-size:14px; } .ds-meta { margin:8px 0 0; color:var(--muted-foreground, #737373); font-size:12px; } .ds-badge-h { padding:2px 10px; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--hojicha, #8f6224); color:#fff; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; } .ds-stars { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin-top:12px; } .ds-on { display:flex; color:var(--hojicha, #8f6224); } .ds-off { display:flex; color:var(--muted-foreground, #737373); } .ds-stars .ds-muted { font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Navbar
components.description: Sticky top bar: wordmark left, auth control right, bottom hairline.
components.html: Matchoji
components.css: .ds-nav { font-family: var(--font-lato), Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; min-height:64px; padding:12px 24px; background:var(--card, #f9f9f9); border-bottom:1px solid var(--border, #d4d4d4); } .ds-wordmark { font-size:20px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.025em; color:var(--foreground, #101010); text-decoration:none; } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring, #a1a1a1); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-nav-btn { font-family: var(--font-lato), Lato, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:none; border-radius:8px; background:var(--primary, #171717); color:var(--primary-foreground, #f9f9f9); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav-btn:hover { opacity:.9; } .ds-nav-btn:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #a1a1a1) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Star Rating Input
components.description: Five 28px star radio buttons, filled in the product's category colour.
components.css: .ds-rate { display:flex; gap:4px; } .ds-star { padding:2px; border:none; background:none; color:var(--muted-foreground, #737373); cursor:pointer; transition:color .15s; } .ds-star-on, .ds-star:hover { color:var(--matcha, #5c7a4f); } .ds-star:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring, #a1a1a1); outline-offset:2px; border-radius:4px; }

narrative.overview:
Matchoji is a working logbook, not a showcase. The ground is a neutral off-white, text is near-black, chrome is greyscale, and one workhorse sans (Lato) carries every word. Against that quiet ledger, exactly two colours do real work: jade marks matcha, amber marks hojicha. Category colour is data. It appears wherever a product or rating appears, so the scarce-matcha, abundant-hojicha contrast reads at a glance across a whole feed.

The system runs in Operate mode: dense enough to scan a grid of products, calm enough to read reviews. Components are shadcn primitives with the category layer applied on top; there is no bespoke component language beyond the category badge, the category-spined product card, and the star rating. Depth is minimal: product cards sit on a faint shadow and lift slightly on hover, and everything else is flat with hairline borders.

The confirmed rejection is the neutral-grayscale rating-app look where category is only a text label (the Vivino and Untappd clone pattern). Here, category is never a label alone.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral off-white ground (#f9f9f9), near-black ink (#101010), greyscale chrome.
Two functional category colours, jade and amber, both carrying white text at WCAG AA.
One typeface, Lato, for everything. No display face.
Flat surfaces with hairline borders; only product cards carry a resting shadow.
Centred 1184px column with 24px gutters on every page.

rules.name: The Category-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Jade and amber appear only where a product's category is being expressed: badge, card spine, star fill, active category tab. They always come from `CATEGORY_STYLES`; no component hard-codes them. The one ambient use is the text-selection tint (jade at 25%), which is native to the world.

rules.name: The Charcoal Action Rule
rules.body: Buttons and other neutral actions are charcoal or outline. A jade "Submit" button would claim every rating is matcha.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Lato only. No display face, no serif accent, no mono in shipped UI. This is Operate, not Persuade.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Separate with 1px hairline borders before reaching for shadow. Only a clickable product card earns a lift.

rules.name: The Pinned Spine Rule
rules.body: Product cards carry a 4px left border in their category colour, with 1px hairlines on the other three sides. This side stripe was pinned by the brief as the card's category signal and overrides the usual ban on side-tab borders. It belongs to the product card only; do not put coloured side stripes on alerts, list rows or other containers.

dos: **Do** pull every jade and amber use from `CATEGORY_STYLES`, so badge, spine, star and tab can never disagree.
**Do** keep white text on both category fills; both were darkened specifically to clear 4.5:1.
**Do** keep neutral actions charcoal or outline, whatever the surrounding category.
**Do** use the 1184px column with 24px gutters and 48px vertical padding on every page.
**Do** make loading skeletons match the final layout's grid and spacing.
**Do** stack the detail page's "Rate it" column above reviews below `lg`.
donts: **Don't** use jade or amber decoratively, for status, or for anything other than a product's category (the 25% jade selection tint is the only ambient exception).
**Don't** add a display face, second family or mono to shipped UI; Lato carries everything.
**Don't** reduce category to a text label alone; any product or rating shown must carry its colour.
**Don't** add coloured side stripes outside the product card.
**Don't** add resting shadows to non-clickable containers; separate them with hairlines.
**Don't** describe or tint the ground as warm; it is neutral off-white (#f9f9f9).
